scenes.say: When prepping for interviews, knowing which performance testing tool to use—and why—can make all the difference.

scenes.label: k6
scenes.sub: JavaScript scripting, command line use, easy CI integration
scenes.say: k6 lets you write tests in JavaScript and run them from the command line. It’s great for continuous integration pipelines.
JMeter offers a visual interface and plugins. Gatling uses Scala or Java for code-driven tests. Locust is Python-based and super flexible.

scenes.question: Is k6 always the best choice?
scenes.right: No, tool choice depends on scripting needs, scalability, and integration options.
scenes.say: Don’t assume k6 is always best. The right tool depends on your scripting needs, scalability, and how it fits into your workflow.
